name: phi-router
description: Sends each model request from Claude Code, Codex or pi to an open account or a BAA account, by whether it holds PHI.

scripts.prepare: [ -x node_modules/.bin/effect-tsgo ] || exit 0; effect-tsgo patch --oxlint && bun tools/formal/install.ts && (git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true)
scripts.suppressions: grep -rnE 'ast-grep-ignore|(oxlint|eslint)-(disable|enable)|oxfmt-ignore|@ts-(expect-error|ignore|nocheck)|@effect-diagnostics' src tools --exclude-dir=fixtures --exclude-dir=anti-slop && echo 'Fix the code the rule caught. A rule that is wrong for this repo goes to the owner, and its off line goes in .oxlintrc.jsonc with the reason.' && exit 1 || true
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && vitest run e2e.test.ts --exclude '.worktrees/**'
scripts.check: oxfmt --check && bun run lint && bun run boundaries && bun run comments && bun run suppressions && bun run unused && bun run test
